questions.prompt: I ___ Aisha. (A am, B is, C she)
steps: I takes am.

questions.prompt: We ___ boy. (A is, B are, C am)
steps: We takes are, and a plural subject should use boys.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: B. Are; corrected sentence: We are boys.

questions.prompt: You ___ stubborn. (A am, B is, C are)
steps: You takes are.

questions.prompt: She ___ happy. (A her, B its, C is)
steps: She takes is.

questions.prompt: He ___ hungry. (A is, B am, C are)

questions.prompt: Jamila is my best friend. ___ love cooking. (I, WE, YOU, SHE, IT, THEY, HE)
steps: She requires loves, so there is no pronoun that both refers back to Jamila and agrees with the printed verb love.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: As printed: I, we, you or they can agree with love. If referring to Jamila: She loves cooking.
